hypotheses.paper: the BTZ model space E0 = R^3 with the singular structure induced by the flat metric -2dtau dr + dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2 (l.1944)
hypotheses.note: E0 = Gamma_{2pi}\(D_inf x R) (homeomorphic to C x R, GX.cylHomeomorph) with the structure developed on {r>0} by D (GX.IsBTZStructure; exists and unique, GX.btz_existsUnique). The metric content is now PROVED (audit-1 major fix): the paper's D verbatim in its coordinates (tau,r,theta), GX.btzPaperDev, equals btzDevM 0 btzV0 composed with (tau,r,theta) -> (r,-theta,2tau) (GX.btzPaperDev_eq_btzDevM on r>0, GX.btzPaperDev_axis on r=0), and its derivative pulls the Minkowski form back to the printed metric at every point: minkQ(dD_p h) = -2 dtau dr + dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2 (GX.btzPaperDev_pullback) and the polarised tensor identity (GX.btzPaperDev_pullback_minkB). The charts of E0's structure are local isometries of the printed metric, as ONE theorem (audit-2 minor 1): for every chart c in the atlas and every p = (tau,r,theta) with r > 0 in its domain, q -> c(pi(r,-theta,2tau)) is locally g . D for some g in Isom0 (GX.btz_chart_eq_smul_btzPaperDev), differentiable at p, and pulls -dt^2+dx^2+dy^2 back to -2dtau dr + dr^2 + r^2 dtheta^2 (GX.btz_chart_pullback; for E0 itself GX.btzE0_chart_pullback). The converse (every oriented, time-oriented local isometry of the metric is a chart) is Liouville for flat Lorentzian metrics, left to WP-39c's lem:liouville. The printed 'r^2 dtheta' is read r^2 dtheta^2 (a typo: r^2 dtheta is not a quadratic form).

hypotheses.paper: G = Isom0(E^{1,2}) (l.668: orientation and time-orientation preserving), X = E^{1,2}
hypotheses.note: Causal.Flat.isom 2 (linear part in Causal.Flat.lorentz 2: det 1, time-orientation preserving), Causal.Minkowski 2 (lean-causal pinned 731ed99)
btz_virt_tame holds for every x0, every v with <v|u> < 0, every alpha != 0; the paper's instance is GX.btzE0_virt_tame (alpha = 2pi, x0 = 0, v = (-1,1,0)) with no hypothesis

D-5: theta in R. The printed D verbatim is GX.btzPaperDev = btzDevM 0 btzV0 o ((tau,r,theta) -> (r,-theta,2tau)) (GX.btzPaperDev_eq_btzDevM): the printed sign of y is the cylinder map theta -> -theta (which conjugates Gamma_alpha to itself by k -> k^-1), not a spatial reflection (Isom0 has none); GX.btzDevM_paper_coords gives btzDevM 0 btzV0 at (r,theta,2tau) = (tau + r theta^2/2, tau + r theta^2/2 - r, +r theta)

findings: l.2257-2258 (D-6, as planned): 'the image of U_lambda in BTZ contains {r < lambda/4pi^2} and is thus open' is a non sequitur (containing an open set does not make a set open; and the quotient topology must be checked on all T-open sets, not on the U_lambda). Repaired proof of (A): a Gamma-invariant T_BTZ-open set is open for the natural topology (translate a point of a small natural box at an axis point by the k in Gamma bringing its angle into [-alpha/2, alpha/2], where r theta^2 <= r alpha^2/4), GX.isOpen_of_isOpen_tamTop_of_invariant / GX.coinduced_orbitMk_tamTop. The statement stands.

l.2256 and l.1955-1956: (B), (C), (D) of virtual tameness are asserted in the motivational example without proof; all are proved here (D is T_BTZ-continuous and a developing map over p^{-1}(reg); Gamma(BTZ~/BTZ) = Gamma_alpha acts T-continuously; {r>0} is T-portly), as is the stronger claim that all of Aut(BTZ~) acts T-continuously (GX.btz_aut_continuous), the model hypothesis of theo:local_virt_tame (GX.btz_hasAutContinuousTamifying).

l.2249-2250: D(BTZ~) = J^+(Delta), D injective, Gamma = Z, Gamma fixing p^-1(Sing) pointwise, rho(gamma) fixing Delta pointwise and parabolic are all true and proved (GX.btz_dev_injective_range, GX.btzDeckEquiv, GX.btz_deck_fix_sing, GX.btzHol_smul_of_mem_btzLine, GX.btzHol_isParabolic); in fact rho(gamma) is parabolic and fixes Delta for EVERY gamma != 1, either generator included (GX.btzHolonomy_isParabolic, via btzHol^n = btzHol at angle n*alpha, GX.btzHol_zpow); 'Delta lightlike => phi parabolic' needs phi != 1 (D-1), which holds (alpha != 0, GX.btzHol_ne_one).

T_BTZ = T_natural inf D^*T_{M3} (GX.hornTop_eq_inf_induced, GX.btzTop_eq): the BTZ topology is the coarsest topology finer than the natural one making D continuous; relevant to defi:BTZtop / prop:quotient_chart (WP-41h).
l.1944: the printed metric '-2 dtau dr + dr^2 + r^2 dtheta' lacks a square on dtheta; with r^2 dtheta^2 it is exactly D^*(-dt^2+dx^2+dy^2) for the printed D of l.1947 (GX.btzPaperDev_pullback).
questions: The paper's 'singular structure induced by the flat metric' (l.1944) has no library notion of metric; the file proves the structure is the one developed by the paper's D and that D^*eta is the printed metric at every point (GX.btzPaperDev_pullback, with r^2 dtheta read r^2 dtheta^2). Per audit-1's own fix this closes the row; if the master instead wants the metric-induced (G,X)-structure as a separate definition with an equality theorem, that is a new library notion (Lorentzian metric + local isometry atlas) and the row would be partial pending it.

kb_proposals: T_BTZ (GX.hornTop) = natural ⊓ induced btzDevM (GX.hornTop_eq_inf_induced): to prove a self-map T_BTZ-continuous, show it naturally continuous and D ∘ f = g • D (continuous_inf_rng + continuous_induced_rng).

An a.e. automorphism of \widetilde{𝔼₀} transports to the cylinder as Φ ∘ φ ∘ Φ⁻¹ through eq_aePullback (p^*B = Φ^*A, the massCyl_timeShift_mem_aeAut pattern); the cylinder's regular locus is exactly {r>0} (GX.support_btzCyl), so it preserves {r>0}.

Statements about deckGroup (SpreadEnd.base : MaxBranchedCover … → _) time out (whnf) with `_` placeholders, `set`, or a MulEquiv.refl cast GammaA α ≃* Multiplicative ℤ: write γ.1 e, give explicit terms, and use an explicit equivalence (GX.gammaAEquivInt).

With a non-instance topology (hornTop), write @nhdsWithin _ hornTop p s, @Continuous.tendsto _ _ hornTop _ _ h p and @self_mem_nhdsWithin _ hornTop p s; dot-notation `.tendsto` elaborates with the default instance and fails with 'synthesized instance not defeq'.
btzDev factors through (r, rθ, rθ², t) (GX.btzDev_eq_btzAff): continuity at the axis and the cluster values of D (GX.btzDev_cluster, every limit lies on x₀ + [t,∞)u) reduce to these four functions.

A pullback-metric identity for a polynomial developing map: write D = nullToMink o P (P polynomial into R x R x R), get HasFDerivAt P by fst/snd/.mul/.pow/.prodMk, compose with (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap nullToMink).hasFDerivAt, and close minkB/minkQ by simp [minkB, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]; ring (GX.btzPaperDev_pullback_minkB).
In a theorem with hypothesis hγ : γ ≠ 1 on a deckGroup element, `obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := btzDeckOf_surjective hα hΦ γ` times out (isDefEq); `have hs := ...; obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hs` does not.

An element g of Causal.Flat.isom d acts on a differentiable map by its linear part: g . f q = g.linear (f q) + g . 0 (Causal.Flat.isom_sub with p = 0), then (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap _).hasFDerivAt.comp p hf |>.add_const; minkQ is preserved by lorentz.minkQ_apply (mem_isom_iff.1 g.2) (GX.hasFDerivAt_isom_smul, GX.btz_chart_pullback).
